bio.text: Jocelyn Brasher, a Democrat, is a candidate for Nebraska Attorney General in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the May 12, 2026 Democratic primary.
She earned a bachelor's degree in philosophy from Auburn University and a law degree from Creighton University School of Law.

Her career includes work as a law clerk in the Douglas County Attorney's Office, deputy county attorney in Dawson and Dodge Counties, Assistant Attorney General in the Nebraska Attorney General's Office, and attorney at Lamson Dugan & Murray LLP.
